report.summary: Chunk 3 of 5 of deepseek.py: contains backup restore, path resolution, and rewrite logic with egress checks. Public symbols: restore_all, _resolve, _run_rewrite. Claims checked: restore_all restores files and cleans dirs; _resolve prevents path traversal; _run_rewrite enforces per-file egress checks and budget accounting.
risks: _run_rewrite | medium | The method reads file content and sends it over the network via chat_completion. If the egress checks fail, the file content is still read into memory before the check. An attacker who can trigger a read of a sensitive file may cause data to be temporarily held in memory. | Confirm whether memory is zeroed after use or if the original variable is garbage-collected promptly.

_run_rewrite | low | The method uses a hard-coded MAX_REWRITE_FILES and MAX_REWRITE_CHARS. If these constants are not correctly configured or are too large, the method may attempt to process many large files, causing high memory or API costs. | Verify the values of these constants and ensure they are appropriate for the deployment.
todos: Verify that the constants MAX_REWRITE_FILES and MAX_REWRITE_CHARS are defined and have reasonable values.
Check that the egress check using classify_data and slice_egress_rule is correctly implemented and covers all necessary cases.
Ensure that the method handles the case where the model returns an empty or invalid response.

claims.text: restore_all restores files from backups and removes empty created directories.
claims.why: The code iterates over backups, writes original bytes or deletes file if original is None; then removes empty created directories deepest first.

claims.text: _resolve raises ValueError if the resolved path escapes repo root (traversal/symlink/absolute).
claims.why: The code compares root and target; if root != target and root not in target.parents, it raises ValueError.

claims.text: _run_rewrite sends one request per file, each file costs one paid API call.
claims.why: The method loops over paths and calls chat_completion per file; calls variable is incremented.

claims.text: The call goes through _openai_compat.chat_completion for budget accounting interposed at urlopen.
claims.why: The code does not show the actual call to chat_completion; it is outside this chunk.

claims.text: Every file passes an INDIVIDUAL egress check before its body is put on an untrusted wire.
claims.why: The code performs classify_data and slice_egress_rule checks on the file content before proceeding with the rewrite.

claims.text: A denylisted file must be refused here exactly as this provider's docstring promises.
claims.why: The docstring of the provider is not in this chunk; the claim refers to it.

claims.text: Leading with the target makes it the frame the request is read inside rather than a detail at the end of it.
claims.why: The actual prompt construction is not shown in this chunk.

claims.text: A brief-less prompt (empty string) degrades to the pre-brief behaviour rather than failing the call.
claims.why: The prompt construction and handling of empty brief is not in this chunk.

observations.what: The method reads the file content before performing egress checks; if the check fails, the content is still in memory.
The method uses hard-coded MAX_REWRITE_FILES and MAX_REWRITE_CHARS constants which are not defined in this chunk.
The method does not handle the case where chat_completion returns an error or empty response; error handling is not shown.
